en.topic_title: Jailed Hong Kong pro-democracy campaigner Joshua Wong pleads guilty to foreign collusion charge
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong pro-democracy campaigner Joshua Wong has pleaded guilty to conspiracy to collude with foreign forces – his second conviction under a Beijing-imposed national security law following a landmark subversion case.
